title: ReviewRubric
description: Cacheable, versioned rubric a heavyweight author writes once and a cheap grader applies per candidate (two-turn reviewer economics). Items are {text, axis, weight in {1,2,3}}. Axes follow per-domain templates (code: file-change/spec-alignment/integrity/runtime; QA: grounding/question-alignment/integrity-no-fabrication/completeness; math: answer/method/integrity/coverage) but the schema is domain-general (intake-834). Immutable once published; new versions are new artifacts.

rubric_id.description: Stable identifier; (rubric_id, version) is the cache key.

version.description: Rubric content version (semver). Bump = new cacheable artifact.

domain.description: Domain template the axes are drawn from.

grading_scale.description: Optional pointwise grading scale each item is scored on (default 0-1).

id.description: Item id (R1, R2, ...); referenced by rubric-grading responses.

text.description: The criterion, phrased as a checkable question.

axis.description: Grading axis (per-domain template, e.g. spec-alignment, grounding, integrity, method).
